data.name: 22’ Capri Sailboat
data.headline: 1-8 Hour options • Ages 18+ • Up to 7 people
data.description: This 22’ sailboat rental comfortably accommodates up to seven passengers. The Capri 22’ sailboat rental offers more room and performance, making it the perfect boat to use to develop your sailing skills in San Diego.
data.highlights:
-Life vests included
-All boats are required to stay within the bay

meeting_point.address: 1404 Vacation Rd, San Diego, CA 92109 We are on the Dock out in front of Barefoot Bar & Grill.
